# Tesla

Every app in this list that runs on Tesla. That is 6 apps with 4 for Plex and 3 for Jellyfin and 1 for Emby. Apps for more than one server count once per server. The legend is in [README.md](../README.md#legend) and every other platform is in [PLATFORMS.md](../PLATFORMS.md).

> **Want these apps to play straight from debrid or Usenet?** [rex](https://rex.debridmediamanager.com/) and [zurg](https://zurg.debridmediamanager.com/) are made by the team that keeps this list. [See what they do.](../README.md#from-the-maintainers)

## Video and general

- [BackseatFin](https://github.com/jiaton/backseatfin) - Client that runs in a car's web browser, even while the car is moving. `Jellyfin` `Emby` · `Web` `Tesla` · `MIT` `Free`
- [canvas](https://github.com/bleichroeder/canvas) - In-car browser video player for Plex and YouTube using canvas and WebCodecs. `Plex` · `Tesla` · `MIT`
- [DashStream](https://github.com/bierzelt-kind/dashstream) - Web player tuned for the Tesla in-car browser, for films from Jellyfin and audiobooks from Audiobookshelf. `Jellyfin` `+Audiobookshelf` · `Web` `Tesla` · `Open source` `Free`
- [iCar for Tesla](https://apps.apple.com/de/app/icar-for-tesla/id6801842057) - Tesla companion app for charging, trips and navigation, with in-car video from your Plex or Jellyfin library. `Plex` `Jellyfin` · `iOS` `iPadOS` `Tesla` · `Free`

## Music

- [Mayhem](https://github.com/8layer8/Mayhem) - Plex audio player for the Tesla in-car browser. `Plex` · `Web` `Android TV` `Tesla` · `MIT`
- [tesla-plex-player](https://github.com/CleJason/tesla-plex-player) - Music player for the Tesla in-car browser. `Plex` · `Tesla` · `Open source`
